content.text:
Booking was failing because the insert in `src/repos/appointments.ts` wrote to a `created_by` column. Migration 004 had renamed that column to `created_by_user_id`, so the insert errored. I fixed the column name and added a POST test, and typecheck and all 19 tests pass.

For future failures, `route()` in `src/lib/http.ts` now generates an `errorId`, logs one error line with the id, the route (`METHOD /path`) and the cause, and returns `{ errorId }` with the 500. The cause is only the error name and its code, errno and SQL state, never the message or SQL text, because driver errors can contain row values. The one exception is the column name from "Unknown column" errors. I didn't check the Apache access log; this change doesn't touch it, and the booking request has no patient data in its URL.
